facts.business: Timex Group India Limited manufactures and sells watches in India, operating in the premium and luxury segments of the Indian watch industry.
key_risks: Potential supply disruptions from geopolitical developments
Heightened volatility in global financial markets
Conflict in West Asia disrupting global supply chains
facts.related_party_note: Preference shares held by and redeemed to M/s Timex Group Luxury Watches B.V. (TGLW), the Holding Company; dividends on preference shares paid to holding company.
